name: KRC v0.4 — Typed Korean Construction Microgrammar, Presupposition-Sensitive Linearization & Source-Traceable Prose
scientific_question: Can a small source-grounded realization calculus produce more than one grammatically plausible Korean surface order while conserving asserted role-bearing chunks and refusing forbidden semantic transformations?
research_object: Korean sentence formation, not consensus/approval nor a 'human-written detection' score.
prior_failures: v0.1 0.6B basic prose/logic failure, withdrawn reader survey
v0.2 9/10 literal copies and lexical critic false negatives
v0.3 4B sentences improved superficially but 6/6 outputs had source or pragmatic concerns, and typed plan identifiers leaked

scope.source: Two newly authored fictional Korean micro-documents EX11 EX12 with five propositions each
scope.kind: Small closed-domain grammar with case-marked phrase movement, not a universal Korean grammar or pretrained LLM.

operations.name: ADJUNCT_FRONT
requires: overt adjunct and fixed predicate role
operations.post: conserve all source clause tokens/semantic frame with adjunct fronted

operations.name: TOPIC_FIRST
operations.post: conserve source fragments; optional discourse pragmatic effect remains UNKNOWN

operations.name: EPISTEMIC_LIMIT_LINK
requires: immediately preceding RESULT and next NOT_MEASURED
operations.post: insert limited connective 다만 to mark caveat, not a cause

operations.name: NO_UNLICENSED_CAUSE
operations.post: fail closed if no source warrant

operations.name: NO_UNLICENSED_NEGATION_CHANGE
operations.post: fail closed if requested polarity differs

operations.name: NO_UNLICENSED_NARRATOR_ELLIPSIS
operations.post: fail closed if antecedent not unique

invariants: same semantic record pointers before/after permitted ordering operations
each source fact represented exactly once per passage
generated sentence contains only source-licensed Korean fragments plus declared discourse connective
reject unsupported predicate-polarity reversals and invented causal edges
do not claim valid Korean grammar from token multiset conservation alone
formal_limit: Structural preservation and provenance are machine-checkable; truth-conditional and pragmatic equivalence of different Korean word orders requires independent linguistic validation. Token movement can change emphasis/contrast.

test_plan.positive: two genres × 2 deterministic surface arrangements = 4 tangible passages, at least four truly reordered sentences and no added fact predicates
test_plan.execution: Node.js 22 pure deterministic microgrammar and built-in unit tests, no model weights or external API
test_plan.source_status: assistant-authored controlled examples; not a confirmatory writing corpus

exit: Stop after concrete tests, record failures. Next expansion must involve Korean clause morphology and discourse context, not another generic evaluator architecture.
